refused
  The sole failed decision occurred at the start of execution of a demonstrated stick-navigation route. Carried memory was empty, and the visible demonstration first moved to the adjacent larger-x target along an image-lower arc, then reversed and made three smaller-x image-lower traversals. The policy chose B rather than C and reported no missing information or unclear rule. The annotated route was ["C","B","B","B"]. This does not establish a SUFFICIENCY or NECESSITY defect: the existing instructions explicitly map a larger-x image-lower traversal to C, require decoding the full demonstration, and require selecting its first letter without removing it at initialization. They also prohibit substituting a location-based fallback for a supported demonstration move. The observed error is therefore already addressed by the documents, and no memory field, update event, or subgoal rule change is justified.
